children: Grades were mixed on Tuesday, dealers said, as investors eyed mediation discussions in the Middle East alongside a drop in domestic oil stocks.
Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian discussed  and regional developments during a meeting with Pakistan's army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir in Tehran, Iran's Nournews reported on Tuesday.
Pakistan's mediation efforts resulted in an interim peace agreement ​signed in ⁠June. But that deal quickly faltered amid new fighting between Iran and the US weeks later.
US crude oil, distillate and gasoline inventories fell in the latest week, market sources said on Tuesday, citing data from the American Petroleum Institute.
Crude stocks fell by 4.9 million barrels in the week ended October 16, the sources said on the condition of anonymity.
Gasoline stocks fell by nearly 2 million barrels, while distillate inventories dropped by about 2.6 million barrels compared with a week earlier, the sources said.

Two top US energy department officials said on Tuesday they were working with refiners at home and abroad to boost fuel output as a diesel shortage raises worries about prices and inflation ahead of the November midterm elections.

The Trump administration has taken several steps to try to lower fuel prices that have surged since the start of the Iran war on February 28, including relaxing restrictions on Russian diesel exports, invoking the Defense Production Act to boost output, and allowing commercial vehicles to run on red-dyed diesel normally limited to off-road equipment.
